name: RMG worker, grade G1 at Tk 14,750, last day 13 October: 13 of 31 days, with an absent day and overtime
source: hand-worked from the BD pack rules
working: Full-month split: BASIC = round((14750 − 2450) ÷ 1.5) = round(8200) = 8200; HOUSE_RENT = 14750 − 8200 − 750 − 450 − 1250 = 4100; MEDICAL 750, CONVEYANCE 450, FOOD 1250
Grade G1 minimum is gross 14750 and basic 8200: met
Employed 1–13 Oct (separatedOn, the last day employed, is 13 Oct) = 13 of 31 days; each structure line is paid × 13 ÷ 31
Prorated gross = 14750 × 13 ÷ 31 = 6185.48 → 6185; the rounded lines add up to 3439 + 1719 + 315 + 189 + 524 = 6186, 1 taka over, so it is taken off the structure's last line
OVERTIME = round(BASIC × 2 × OT hours ÷ 208) on the full monthly basic = round(8200 × 2 × 6 ÷ 208) = round(473.08) = 473
ABSENCE = round(BASIC ÷ 30 × absent days) on the full monthly basic = round(8200 ÷ 30 × 1) = round(273.33) = 273
Final settlement items (notice pay, unused leave, gratuity) are the settlement's, not this run's, and are not in this case
